claims.claim: P = NP implies polynomial-time key recovery for Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA, because key recovery is an NP witness-search problem.
claims.brief_label: theorem — proven, conditional on the premise
claims.label: established

claims.label: established

claims.claim: Proof-of-History-style sequential ordering retains meaningful hardness under P = NP, because its hardness is depth-based rather than search-based.
claims.label: open
